title: AppButton — replace Container+GestureDetector with FilledButton/OutlinedButton/TextButton
objective: Refactor lib/ui/core/widgets/buttons/app_button.dart so the visual block uses Material 3 FilledButton (primary), OutlinedButton (secondary), and TextButton (ghost/tertiary) widgets instead of a hand-rolled Container + BoxDecoration + GestureDetector stack. Public API stays identical: same constructor, same AppButtonVariant, same AppButtonSize, same isLoading/isDisabled/isFullWidth/icon/trailingIcon parameters.
description: The current implementation builds a Container with BoxDecoration (color, border, borderRadius) wrapped in GestureDetector to handle taps, then layers _HoverOpacityWrapper and _PressScaleWrapper on top for press feedback. After this batch, the underlying visual block is a real Material button (FilledButton.icon / OutlinedButton / TextButton) whose style is computed from the AppButtonVariant. The hover/press wrappers are preserved (they are token-driven and respect MediaQuery.disableAnimationsOf) but become cosmetic layers around the Material widget rather than the click target. icon + trailingIcon + label become the Material widget's child (Row). The CircularProgressIndicator in isLoading is preserved as the child when loading.

anchors: lines 26-50 — AppButtonVariant + AppButtonSize enums (keep verbatim, this is the public API)
lines 103-131 — _sizeTokens / _horizontalPaddingTokens / _verticalPaddingTokens / _iconLabelGapTokens / _iconSizeTokens (keep verbatim, replace lookup site in build)
lines 137-181 — _backgroundColor/_foregroundColor/_borderColor/_borderWidth (refactor to return ButtonStyle values consumed by filledButtonTheme/styles)
lines 187-227 — build() (replace _buildButtonChild body to return a Material button widget; keep _HoverOpacityWrapper + _PressScaleWrapper composition)
lines 229-266 — _buildContent (becomes the child passed to the Material widget — keep Row layout and CircularProgressIndicator behavior identical)
lines 268-304 — _buildButtonChild (DELETE this method; build returns the Material button directly)
lines 316-381 — _HoverOpacityWrapper + _PressScaleWrapper (keep verbatim, they remain the cosmetic feedback layer)

variant_to_widget_mapping.primary: FilledButton.icon (or FilledButton with Row child) — AppColors.cta background, white foreground
variant_to_widget_mapping.secondary: OutlinedButton.icon — transparent background, primary indigo border 1.5px, primary indigo foreground
variant_to_widget_mapping.tertiary: FilledButton.tonalIcon or TextButton.icon (default to TextButton.icon when running on surface) — surface fill, text-primary foreground
variant_to_widget_mapping.ghost: TextButton.icon — transparent background, primary indigo foreground

size_to_style_mapping.sm: height 36px, padding 8/12 (Spacing.space_2xs / Spacing.space_xs), icon 16px, label buttonSmall
size_to_style_mapping.md: height 44px, padding 12/16 (Spacing.space_xs / Spacing.space_sm), icon 20px, label buttonMedium

loading_state: When isLoading=true, replace the label Text with a 20x20 CircularProgressIndicator(strokeWidth: 2, valueColor: AlwaysStoppedAnimation(foreground)) — this row becomes the Material button's child.
disabled_state: When isDisabled=true, set onPressed=null AND wrap child in Opacity(0.5). Preserve existing effectiveOnPressed/effectiveOpacity logic verbatim.
full_width_state: When isFullWidth=true, set SizedBox(width: double.infinity) around the Material button (the Material button itself has a built-in default minimum width; the SizedBox enforces parent fill).
acceptance_criteria: lib/ui/core/widgets/buttons/app_button.dart compiles without errors (no reference to deleted _buildButtonChild or its Container/GestureDetector stack in build)
The visible widget is one of: FilledButton(.icon), OutlinedButton(.icon), or TextButton(.icon) — chosen by AppButtonVariant
AppButtonVariant.primary renders FilledButton.icon with backgroundColor AppColors.cta and white foreground
AppButtonVariant.secondary renders OutlinedButton.icon with transparent background and primary indigo border (width 1.5)
AppButtonVariant.tertiary renders FilledButton.tonalIcon or equivalent (surface fill, text-primary foreground, theme-inherited)
AppButtonVariant.ghost renders TextButton.icon with primary indigo foreground and transparent fill
Each Material button's style uses Radii.button borderRadius (not a hardcoded number)
isLoading=true replaces the label with a 20x20 CircularProgressIndicator (strokeWidth 2, valueColor foreground) inside the row
isDisabled=true sets onPressed=null and applies Opacity(0.5) on the child
isFullWidth=true wraps the Material button in SizedBox(width: double.infinity)

Public class signature (constructor parameter list, AppButtonVariant enum, AppButtonSize enum, all named-parameter defaults) is unchanged from the pre-batch version — existing call sites compile without change
_HoverOpacityWrapper (lines 316-349) and _PressScaleWrapper (lines 351-381) are preserved as the outer cosmetic layer — they still gate on MediaQuery.disableAnimationsOf(context)
Animation tokens (AppDurations.fast, AppCurves.standard) are still used inside _PressScaleWrapper and _HoverOpacityWrapper — no hardcoded Duration or Curve
Existing call sites anywhere under lib/ that use AppButton still compile unchanged (constructor signature preserved)

validation.signature_preservation: Diff the constructor signature line-for-line; only private helper implementations should change
validation.grep_evidence: grep -n "FilledButton\|OutlinedButton\|TextButton" lib/ui/core/widgets/buttons/app_button.dart should return at least one non-import match
validation.no_raw_stack: grep -n "GestureDetector\|BoxDecoration" lib/ui/core/widgets/buttons/app_button.dart should return zero matches in build()

search_for_callers: Run `rg "AppButton\(" lib/` and confirm no call sites need updating beyond the existing public API.
